_doc: High street fill (claude/fill-high-street, 19 Nov): which business is behind which door of the new high street

rooms.label: library
rooms.name: Coronado Public Library
rooms.why: block 1's landmark: the town library on its main street; the painted PUBLIC LIBRARY sign stays

rooms.label: cafe
rooms.name: Library Grounds Coffee
rooms.why: block 1: coffee next to the library; newspaper boxes and pots at its door, its dumpster behind

rooms.label: stucco
rooms.name: Rosa's Taqueria
rooms.why: block 2: tacos at the foot of the rise for the shops' staff and the park's families, flats above it (a salon was tried: the wide, shallow room stayed bare)

rooms.label: bank
rooms.name: Crownado Savings
rooms.why: block 2: the town's savings bank (its painted CROWNADO SAVINGS sign stays)

rooms.label: corner
rooms.name: Ninth Street Books
rooms.why: block 2: the bookshop on the 9th St corner, papers at its door

rooms.label: hall
rooms.name: Christ Church Community Center
rooms.why: block 2: the church's hall on 9th St (office, meetings); its painted COMMUNITY CENTER sign stays

rooms.label: condo
rooms.name: Swim & Sun
rooms.why: block 3: swimwear and beach clothes under the condos

rooms.label: realty
rooms.name: Ocean Realty
rooms.why: block 3: vacation rentals and sales, listings in the window

rooms.label: condo
rooms.name: Beach Rentals
rooms.why: block 3: bikes, kayaks and umbrellas for hire on Ocean Blvd; its forecourt shows them

rooms.label: pub
rooms.name: The Crown & Anchor
rooms.why: block 4: the evening after the beach; its kitchen dumpster behind on the rear lot

rooms.label: skate
rooms.name: Ocean Park Skate
rooms.why: block 4: the skate shop of Ocean Park: boards for sale and rent, on its own plaza; the roll-up side is its store

rooms.label: post
rooms.name: Coronado Post Office
rooms.why: block 5: the town's post office on its main street, laid out as a counter hall (the bank layout: the counter, the queue, desks; the office layout left 303 m2 bare); its vans on the rear lot

rooms.label: bankph
rooms.name: Hill Savings
rooms.why: block 6: the hill's savings bank on its main street

rooms.label: corner
rooms.name: Ninth Street Pharmacy
rooms.why: block 6: the chemist by the paseo, nearest the rec center and the hill

rooms.label: a1
rooms.name: Hilltop Market
rooms.why: block 6: the corner shop the hill walks to, under three storeys of flats on 9th St; newspapers and the ice chest at its door

rooms.label: rec_center
rooms.name: Hill Rec Center
rooms.why: block 6: the hill's rec center hall (classes, the after-school club), the community-hall layout
